dimensions.assessment: Affects the George C. Marshall International Center, the Department of the Interior, and adjacent property owners in Virginia.
dimensions.evidence: The General George C. Marshall House, in the Commonwealth of Virginia, is established as an affiliated area of the National Park System.

dimensions.assessment: Provides administrative, technical, and potential financial assistance for marketing, marking, interpretation, and preservation, while protecting adjacent land use rights.
dimensions.evidence: Nothing in this Act affects the land use rights of private property owners adjacent to the General George C. Marshall House.

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes cooperative agreements for financial assistance and requires a management plan within three years of funds being made available.
dimensions.evidence: may provide technical assistance and enter into cooperative agreements with the management entity for the purpose of providing financial assistance

dimensions.assessment: Designates a new affiliated area of the National Park System and sets specific management, planning, and interagency agreement requirements.
dimensions.evidence: designates the General George C. Marshall House, in the Commonwealth of Virginia, as an affiliated area of the National Park System

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent affiliated area designation and ongoing management framework under National Park System policies.
dimensions.evidence: The General George C. Marshall House, in the Commonwealth of Virginia, is established as an affiliated area of the National Park System.

missing_information: Exact federal funding amounts or costs associated with cooperative agreements are not specified in the text.
importance_detail.rationale: Designates the General George C. Marshall House in Virginia as an affiliated area of the National Park System, establishing a management entity, cooperative agreements, and a management plan without federal property acquisition or operational responsibility.
